title: Checkpoint and recovery card
body_excerpt:
# Checkpoint and recovery card
## Structure
Target card -> current requirement -> adjacent `stuck?` recovery path.
## Recipe
- Use one blue target card with white text.
- Keep the recovery path black on white and action-oriented.
- State a measurable target, not motivational copy.
- On mobile, stack target before recovery.
## Avoid
Progress decoration without a measurable condition, vague encouragement, or success communicated by color alone.

title: Course title slide
body_excerpt:
# Course title slide
## Structure
Small series/status label -> large title with one blue phrase -> concise subtitle -> thin rule.
## Recipe
- Use the upper-left quadrant and keep at least half the canvas empty.
- Title 40-54 pt Inter Bold.
- Highlight the unit name or meaningful variable in `#2E6BFE`.
- Keep subtitle black and compact.
- No illustration unless it explains the course topic.
## Avoid
Centered title blocks, logos as wallpaper, gradients, dates and metadata competing with the title.

title: Evidence and caveat band
body_excerpt:
# Evidence and caveat band
## Structure
Optional compact icon/label -> one concise sentence -> optional source or method detail.
## Recipe
- Lavender `#DADBF0` fill with `#272525` text.
- Use 12-20 px equivalent padding and 4-6 px radius.
- Keep the band visually subordinate to the title and main content.
- Reserve for claims, caveats, prompts, and evidence; never as decoration.
## Avoid
Stacking multiple bands, embedding long paragraphs, or using low-contrast lavender text.

title: Insight-first chart card
body_excerpt:
# Insight-first chart card
## Structure
Insight title -> unit/period -> chart -> direct annotation -> source/method note.
## Recipe
- Highlight one series or bar in `#2E6BFE`.
- Render comparisons in gray/charcoal.
- Use thin `#E8E8E8` gridlines and direct labels.
- Put exact source and method below or beside the visual.
- Use `#4950BC` only for interactive selection or link behavior.
## Avoid
Rainbow legends, raw chart-library defaults, unlabeled axes, 3D charts, and titles that merely repeat the metric name.

title: Numbered method strip
body_excerpt:
# Numbered method strip
## Structure
Common baseline -> 3-4 numbered zones -> bold action -> one-line explanation -> optional lavender caveat.
## Recipe
- Keep all steps at equal visual level unless one is the current step.
- Use thin black/gray rules, not separate floating cards.
- Number with compact labels or circles.
- Blue may highlight the active variable, deadline, or result.
## Avoid
Long paragraphs, decorative arrows, mixed icon sets, or more than four visible steps in one row.

title: Two-column comparison
body_excerpt:
# Two-column comparison
## Structure
Shared question -> two aligned columns -> matched comparison rows -> conclusion band.
## Recipe
- Use identical row order on both sides.
- Apply blue fill to one side only when the contrast benefits from an anchor.
- Keep the conclusion in a lavender band across both columns.
- State why the difference matters; do not stop at listing attributes.
## Avoid
Unequal categories, mismatched baselines, or two bright colored panels competing for attention.
